content:
**PR 5 of #998: findings per verdict, the reviews timeline, the verdict queue**

snapshot.mjs's reviewRows now carries each verdict's findings as the
shaped array parseVerdict already extracts ({id, severity,
evidenceExcerpt, cites}, excerpt truncated to 240 chars) instead of a
count, plus a separate findingCount (null when uncomputable, 0 when
genuinely empty). New lib/review-timeline.mjs turns the snapshot's
{prs, reviews} sections into one thread per PR (rounds oldest first,
findings grouped bySeverity, any severity string kept) plus the verdict
queue (the two "waiting on a verdict right now" cases: no round, or
latest REVISE). drawer-model.mjs's reviewEntries gains one child row per
finding. app.js's reviews mode router now draws the queue and one card
per thread; view-model.mjs's PLACEHOLDERS.reviews is null. app.css adds
--severity-* token pairs for the three severities reviewer-protocol.md
declares (blocker, correction, editorial) plus an unknown fallback.
